description: Mara owns a lightly used espresso machine at a neighborhood swap meet and must make the final call on a sale to one interested person, settling the price, extras, electrical arrangement, and paperwork after hearing from everyone present.

shared_context.S1: Mara is offering one lightly used espresso machine at the neighborhood swap meet.
shared_context.S2: Mara makes the final decision about the sale and its exact terms.
shared_context.S3: The machine is displayed with its portafilter, water tank, and power cord.
shared_context.S4: At this swap meet, interested people state their offers and practical requirements in turn before the owner closes an informal deal.

PF1.text: Devon will pay exactly $425 and will add two unopened one-pound bags of espresso beans; Devon wants the machine and its displayed accessories, with payment at handoff.

PF2.text: Lina will pay exactly $400 in cash at pickup for the machine and its displayed accessories.

PF3.text: Owen inspected this model previously and knows that it must be operated on a dedicated 20-amp circuit rather than an ordinary shared kitchen outlet.

PF4.text: Keisha learned from the manufacturer's local service counter that this model's remaining transferable warranty requires the original purchase receipt; while helping Mara sort boxes last week, Keisha saw that receipt in the machine's side drawer but has not mentioned it to the group.

acceptance_conditions: The machine must be sold to Devon for exactly $425.
The two unopened one-pound bags of espresso beans must be included.
Lina's exact $400 cash alternative must be recorded.
The settlement must require Devon to use a dedicated 20-amp circuit.
The original purchase receipt must be included with the machine.
The $425 Devon offer must be cited as justification for choosing Devon's deal.

content_checks.C4: decisions['dedicated_20_amp_circuit_required'] == True and any(c['type'] == 'electrical_requirement' and c['target'] == 'Devon' and c['detail'] == 'dedicated 20-amp circuit' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C5: decisions['original_receipt_included'] == True and any(c['type'] == 'receipt_inclusion' and c['target'] == 'Devon' and c['detail'] == 'original purchase receipt' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'beans_included' and c['target'] == 'Devon' and c['detail'] == 'two unopened one-pound bags' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Devon's private offer changes the sale price to exactly $425, selects Devon as buyer, and adds two unopened one-pound bags of beans.
Lina's private offer changes the comparison entry from an unknown alternative to exactly $400 cash at pickup.
Owen's technical fact changes the operating commitment from an ordinary outlet assumption to a required dedicated 20-amp circuit.
Keisha's fact changes the handoff from unspecified paperwork to inclusion of the original purchase receipt, which is required for warranty transfer.
